annotations.title: Spreadsheet to CSV, JSON or Parquet

description: Export one Excel or ODS worksheet as a portable table. Select the worksheet and use its first row as column names. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Formatting, formulas and workbook features are not preserved. Cached cell values are exported. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: sheet_export
title: Spreadsheet to CSV, JSON or Parquet
